crossRefs.note: God did so that night; for it was dry on the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.

translations.web: God did so that night; for it was dry on the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.
translations.bsb: And that night God did so. Only the fleece was dry, and dew covered the ground.
translations.kjv: And God did so that night: for it was dry upon the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.
translations.asv: And God did so that night: for it was dry upon the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.
